autotrade.message.inventory.full: §eInventory full - trading paused until output container frees space
config.comment.enabled: Do auto trading with villagers in range
config.comment.voidtradingdelay: Delay in ticks for void trading
config.comment.delayafterteleport: true: Start the delay after the villager was unloaded; false: Start the delay after the trade has been initiated
config.comment.containertimeout: Timeout ticks waiting for container screen to open
config.comment.trapchestdelay: Extra ticks after opening a trapped chest (signal stabilization)
config.comment.tradeinterval: Minimum ticks between villager trade sessions (100 ticks = 5 seconds)
config.comment.interacttimeout: Timeout ticks waiting for trade screen to open
config.comment.sessionzeroprogresscooldo: Cooldown ticks after a MOVING/VOID session that made no progress (all villagers already processed), prevents busy loops; 0=restart immediately (not recommended)
config.comment.containeriointerval: Min ticks between container IO operations (0=check every tick)
config.comment.containerioidleinterval: Ticks to wait when no container IO is needed
config.comment.paireditgive: Click [Grab Give] to use the item in hand
config.comment.paireditgive2: Optional second give item for 2-for-1 trades (leave empty for single-cost pairs)
config.comment.paireditget: Click [Grab Get] to use the item in hand
config.comment.paireditlimit: Max amount of the FIRST give item per trade (the 2nd give item is not price-adjusted and has no limit)
config.comment.paireditenableinput: Auto restock give items from input container
config.comment.paireditenablegive2input: Auto restock give2 items from its own input container
config.comment.paireditinputpos: Input container position as "x y z" (e.g. -13 60 -1)
config.comment.paireditgive2inputpos: Give 2 input container position as "x y z"
config.comment.paireditgive2inputthresho: Restock when give2 items drop to this many slots or fewer (take Restock Amount from give2 input container)
config.comment.paireditenableoutput: Auto deposit products to output container
config.comment.paireditoutputpos: Output container position as "x y z"
config.comment.paireditinputthreshold: Restock when give items drop to this many slots or fewer (default 1 = restock when only 1 stack is left)
config.comment.paireditinputtake: Items to take from input container per restock
config.comment.paireditoutputthreshold: Trigger output when products occupy this many slots or more (default 1 = deposit whenever any product is in inventory)
